description: This is an elegant white nightstand or bedside table featuring a classic design with gracefully curved sides and legs. It includes two drawers, each adorned with ornate, antique-style metallic pull handles. The main body is finished in a bright white, while the drawer fronts appear to have a subtly different, perhaps slightly off-white or pearlescent finish, adding a touch of sophistication. Its compact size and refined aesthetic make it a perfect accent piece for various rooms, offering both storage and a decorative surface.
